Kim / Laura / James / Maria —

Thanks for the context. Attached is Redwood's proposed DPA redline and a short execution memo. Summary of our position: 
- SCCs: We will use Redwood's SCC Annex (based on the 2021 EU Commission text) with a Transfer Impact Assessment addendum. We do not sign custom SCC templates verbatim unless material differences are required; annex will be attached as Exhibit B.
- Controller/Processor: Redwood will sign as Processor; if Hillcrest requires controller-to-controller language for specific cross-product flows we need explicit scope in Exhibit A.
- Subprocessors: We can accept 30 days' notice for new critical subprocessors with a written objection right limited to a reasonable security/privacy impact basis. We prefer a defined objection standard versus an absolute veto.
- Indemnity: We can accept an indemnity carveout for customer misconfiguration where Redwood's logs show misconfiguration on Hillcrest's account; propose specific language in §7.2.
